items.title: WeirdML v2 legacy dataset released: iteration-level results for 162 model variants on 17 tasks, with a data explorer
items.summary: The WeirdML author published the full 8 MB legacy v2 dataset with per-iteration data for 162 model variants (GPT-4 through Fable 5.1) on 17 tasks, plus an explorer page. Official runs move to v3.

items.title: LAION releases the CLAP2 audio dataset: over 1M hours and 365M clips from YouTube, CC and 300+ academic sets
items.summary: A Hugging Face engineer announced the LAION-Audio-XL dataset behind CLAP2, with more than a million hours of audio and 365M clips curated from web and academic collections, for training audio-language models.

items.title: Flash ALOHA: robot learns dynamic, precise tasks at near human speed from 50 demonstrations, said to be fully open source
items.summary: A Stanford team (with Chelsea Finn) reports Flash ALOHA, which learns fast manipulation tasks from only 50 demonstrations via kinesthetic teaching, and says all code is open sourced. The post carries a video and no repo link was visible.

doubt.pushback: No repo or paper link in the post itself, so the open-source claim and the 50-demo result could not be checked here.

reception.summary: Replies are enthusiastic about 50 demos reaching near human speed; the authors answered a question on trajectory replay mismatch by pointing to a tuning guide on their GitHub. A few asked about hardware and safety around people.

items.title: Nanbeige4.3-33B open weights reported ahead of Claude Opus 5 (max) on AutomationBench, 54.2 vs 50.3
items.summary: A leaderboard account reports Nanbeige4.3-33B, Apache 2.0 open weights, scoring 54.2 on AutomationBench against 50.3 for Claude Opus 5 (max), and 52.6 vs 52.2 over Kimi K2.6 on SciCode, trailing only four open models of 428B or more.

doubt.pushback: Numbers come from a third-party post with no linked leaderboard page or model card in the post, so they were not checked.

items.title: Speechify Simba 3.5 text-to-speech now on OpenRouter: 48 languages, streamed audio, $15 per 1M characters
items.summary: Speechify's Simba 3.5 TTS model is callable through the same OpenRouter key as LLMs, with 48 languages and streaming at $15 per 1M characters.

items.title: MiniMax H3 Image on Metal only: cold 2048x2048 image falls from 229s to 61s on an M5 Ultra with byte-identical output
items.summary: A builder reports a native Metal port of MiniMax H3 Image with no PyTorch, where read-ahead of weights in large parallel chunks cut a cold 2048x2048 render from 229s to 61s with identical pixels.

doubt.pushback: Single self-reported run on one machine with no linked repo or script in the post.

items.title: Blackbox Diary: Android diary app that summarises saved material with the on-device Spark-X2.5-4B model, prerelease v1.3.2
items.summary: A community app by Karl-XZ runs Spark-X2.5-4B on Android to build daily summaries from audio and screen capture, with a debug APK release and model import required.

doubt.pushback: Prerelease debug build; the author says only core software tests passed and accuracy, stability and battery use are unverified.
